findings.problem: A6's parity set silently narrows a plan requirement without recording the narrowing. Plan section 5.2 requires the two front doors to 'declare identical labels/zh/hints', while CONTRACT.md section 1.3/A6 compares only path/label/zh/kind/options and excludes hint. The exclusion is not cosmetic: the hints differ TODAY by construction — packages/mpd-tui-plugin/src/settings.ts knobHint() emits `mpd.jsonc <key> — ${BRIDGE_DISCLOSURE} ${BRIDGE_NOT_LOST}`, while packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/src/settings-card.js hintOf() emits `mpd.jsonc <path> — ${BRIDGE_DISCLOSURE}[ — semantics]` with no not-lost clause. t12 is charged with a 'front-door parity attack' against A6 and could either miss real hint drift or raise a false finding.
findings.requiredFix: Add one sentence to CONTRACT.md section 1.3/A6 stating that plan section 5.2's hint clause is SUPERSEDED: hint strings are deliberately not a parity surface (the two doors build them from different sources and already differ), that A3's hint-content requirement binds SETTINGS_KNOBS only, and that t9's byte read of the TUI section is what decides A3's hint contents. Alternatively amend plan section 5.2 the same way.
